modificationDescription: Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Ripple→URipple, selector [pRipple]→[uRipple], .p-ink/.p-ink-active class names renamed to .u-ink/.u-ink-active, @primeuix/utils DOM helper imports rewritten to @ultimate/uix-utils/dom equivalents. Deliberately excludes upstream's BaseComponent/RippleStyle DI-styling registration and UltimateConfig ripple-toggle gating (not required by this task's brief or test; the ripple effect is applied unconditionally) — see UBaseComponent's doc comment for the same Option B architectural exclusion pattern.

Verifies a .u-ink span is created on mousedown (real upstream Ripple listens for the 'mousedown' DOM event via Renderer2, not 'pointerdown' as this task's brief illustratively described — confirmed against the extracted source before finalizing).

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Fluid→UFluid, selector p-fluid→u-fluid, host class .p-fluid→.u-fluid. Real upstream Fluid is a component with an <ng-content> template and a `p-fluid` element selector, NOT an attribute directive with a [pFluid] selector as this task's brief illustratively described — no [pFluid] selector exists anywhere in upstream source; adapted to match the real mechanism per the brief's own instruction to verify against extracted source. Deliberately excludes upstream's Bind/passthrough hostDirectives wiring and FLUID_INSTANCE/PARENT_INSTANCE injection-token parent lookup — see UBaseComponent's doc comment for the same Option B architectural exclusion pattern.

Ultimate-authored test, not derived from upstream's fluid.spec.ts. Tests UFluid as a component (TestBed.createComponent(UFluid)) rather than as an attribute directive, matching the real upstream mechanism.

Ported from the extracted BadgeStyle's own `style`/`classes` shape, but reshaped to a plain {css, classes} object matching UBaseComponent's styleModule contract (Task 4's base-component.spec.ts — no @Injectable DI service, unlike upstream's own @Injectable BadgeStyle extends BaseStyle, and this task's brief's illustrative description). `style` is imported from @ultimate/uix-styles/badge (style-only, no classes export — Task 3's corrected finding that @primeuix/styles never exports a classes object). `classes.root` ported locally with .p-badge*→.u-badge* renaming, and reshaped to take a plain params object directly (value/size/badgeSize/severity) rather than upstream's `{ instance }`-wrapped signature, matching UBaseComponent.cx(key, params)'s actual call contract.

Extracted via extract-primeng-source.mjs from primeng@21.1.9. Adapts only upstream's `Button` component class (lines 576-917 of the extracted file) — not the same file's `ButtonDirective`/`ButtonLabel`/`ButtonIcon` directives, which are out of scope for this task's file list. Button→UButton, selector p-button→u-button, extends UBaseComponent (Task 4), renders a native <button> (matching upstream's own template, not a <div> with ARIA role). Deliberately excludes upstream's passthrough (pt/ptm/Bind) system, buttonProps bulk-props input, badge/badgeSeverity/badgeClass inputs, type/style/styleClass/tabindex/variant/link/plain inputs, autofocus input, ariaLabel input, and content-template (contentTemplate/iconTemplate/loadingIconTemplate) support — none of these appear in this task's Interfaces section, which defines a smaller, spec-mandated signal-input surface. DISCREPANCY: Step 5 instructs importing URipple/UAutoFocus/UFluid/UBadge/USpinnerIcon into the component's `imports` array; only URipple/USpinnerIcon are imported here. UAutoFocus, UFluid, and UBadge are excluded because none can be applied in the template without inputs this task's own Interfaces section omits (no autofocus or badge input is listed for UButton) — an Angular standalone component with an unused `imports` entry fails compilation with NG8113 (confirmed by actually adding all 5 and rebuilding), and applying UAutoFocus's bare `uAutoFocus` selector to silence that warning is not inert (its aliased @Input reads the bare attribute as a truthy string, unconditionally triggering focus() on init — a real behavior change, confirmed against UAutoFocus's own spec). Upstream's real Button never renders a <p-fluid> element itself either — it DI-injects Fluid purely to detect an ancestor <p-fluid> wrapper, a host-DI-lookup mechanism UBaseComponent's scoped-down Option B architecture has no equivalent for; UButton's own `fluid` input already drives `.u-button-fluid` directly via ButtonStyle's classes.root. Upstream's <p-badge> is likewise rendered only conditionally on a `badge` input this task's Interfaces section doesn't define.

Ported from the extracted ButtonStyle's own `style`/`classes` shape, but reshaped to a plain {css, classes} object matching UBaseComponent's styleModule contract (Task 4's base-component.spec.ts — no @Injectable DI service, unlike upstream's own @Injectable ButtonStyle extends BaseStyle, and unlike this task's brief's illustrative ButtonStyle sample, which also used an @Injectable service). `style` is imported from @ultimate/uix-styles/button (style-only, no classes export — Task 3's corrected finding that @primeuix/styles never exports a classes object). `classes.root`/`classes.icon` ported locally with .p-button*→.u-button* renaming and buttonProps? passthrough-fallbacks dropped (no pt system per UBaseComponent), reshaped to take a plain params object directly rather than upstream's (and the brief's illustrative sample's) `{ instance }`-wrapped signature — confirmed against UBaseComponent.cx(key, params)'s actual call contract (packages/ng-core/src/basecomponent/base-component.ts), which invokes `styleModule.classes[key](params)` with flat params, matching the same pattern already established by UBadge's badge-style.ts. classes.spinnerIcon (upstream computes it from instance.cx('icon') entries) and classes.root's p-button-vertical/p-button-link/p-button-plain/p-button-icon-only badge-aware variant are dropped: no vertical/link/plain input exists on UButton per this task's Interfaces section, and this task's spec-mandated tests only require the u-button-loading root class plus a rendered <u-spinner-icon>, delegates loaded-style tracking to @ultimate/uix-styled via UBaseComponent's ngOnInit per the spec's Styling Strategy, unlike PrimeNG's own BaseStyle.
